PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return to Training"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary general_fitness:
    name "Safe postpartum return to strength and conditioning"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Gentle Reconnection" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Breath and Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Walk and Mobilise":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          child_pose 2x30 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Breath and Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Breath and Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Walk and Mobilise":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          child_pose 2x30 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Breath and Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Post Six-Week Clearance Foundations" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Lower Body Foundations":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 30
          hip_flexor_stretch 30
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Walk and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Upper Body Foundations":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 2x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          prone_Y 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30
          child_pose 30
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Lower Body Foundations":
        warmup:
          walking 5m

    WEEK 3:

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Strength Return" (6 weeks):
    WEEK 1:

      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Walk and Core":
